name: pidea
description: Personal IDE Agent - A unified development platform

scripts.dev:postgres: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && sleep 5 && npm run dev:backend
scripts.dev:postgres:rebuild: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache pidea-db && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev:postgres:clean: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache pidea-db && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker volume rm pidea_pidea-db-dev-data && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
scripts.db:clean: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker volume rm pidea_pidea-db-dev-data
scripts.db:rebuild: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
scripts.test:full: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.css:fix: npm run css:backup && npm run css:modernize
scripts.css:fix-safe: npm run css:backup && npm run css:modernize-safe
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Optional: npx playwright install chromium (from backend) for browser tests'

author: fr4iser90
